user.title: Assign water meters
user.description: Select existing ESPHome cumulative water sensors (total_increasing, m³ or L). Hot water is optional. Verify firmware reception first. Optionally select current annual heat allocator totals (HCA units, total_increasing), not archives or temperatures. The detailed card uses the original ESPHome entities. Clearing the selection removes the corresponding helper sensors.

error.same_source: Select different sources for cold and hot water.
error.invalid_source: Select an existing water sensor with total_increasing state class and m³ or L unit.
error.circular_source: Select the original ESPHome sensor to avoid a circular subscription.
error.already_configured: This cold water source is already configured.
error.invalid_heat_source: Select a current annual total without device_class, with total_increasing and unit dilky, dílky or HCA.

abort.already_configured: This cold water source is already configured.

init.title: Change source sensors
init.description: Saving reloads the integration. Clear the optional hot water field to remove its mapping. Optionally select current annual heat allocator totals (HCA units, total_increasing), not archives or temperatures. The detailed card uses the original ESPHome entities. Clearing the selection removes the corresponding helper sensors.
